name: Too Stubborn to Die
text: At the start of any turn, the general heals D3 damage.

name: Horn of Grimnir
text: In your hero phase, if the general is not in combat, roll a dice for each friendly unit that has lost models. On a 3+ one slain model comes back.

name: Spirit of Grimnir
text: You may re-roll the activation roll of Awaken the Runes.

name: Powerful Presence
text: The general's Control characteristic is 3 higher.
